Replaces Grenade Ability with 'Cage of Loyal Moths', grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge. Overrides Base (T3) Grenade Ability cooldown to 73 seconds.

Moth Cage explodes on impact, releasing 2 loyal moths that fly to their nearest target.

Loyal Moths variants:
• <arc/>Arc Moths: slower-flying, offensive role. They seek out targets and detonate on contact, dealing up to <pve 526 /> <pvp [31] /> damage. Counts as <arc/>Arc Grenade Damage.
• <void/>Void Moths: faster-flying, support role. They seek out allies and grant them a 22.5 HP <void/>Void Overshield on contact.

When no enemies are around, it spawns 2 Void Moths. When enemies are around and you (and allies?) are at or near full HP, it spawns 2 Arc Moths.
When enemies are around and you (and allies?) are low HP, it spawns 1 Arc Moth and 1 Void Moth (maybe??). Needs more testing.

Loyal Moths variants:
• <arc/>Arc Moths: slower-flying, offensive role. They seek out targets and detonate on contact, dealing up to <pve 526 /> <pvp [31] /> damage over a 4 meter radius and <arc/>Blinding targets. Counts as <arc/>Arc? Grenade Damage.
• <void/>Void Moths: faster-flying, support role. They seek out allies and grant them a 22.5 HP <void/>Void Overshield on contact.

When no enemies are within ? meters of the detonation area, it spawns 2 Void Moths. When only enemies are around, it spawns 2 Arc Moths.

When both allies and enemies are around, it spawns 1 Arc Moth and 1 Void Moth.
